label: Release plan
title: Give a plan its own vocabulary.
introduction: A tiny custom prelude defines workflow, step and a closed set of actions.
preludeExcerpt:
(type Action
  (Union "process.test" "human.approve"))

(form (step name action)
  :types {:name (Declares Step) :action Action}
  :ir StepIR …)
prelude:
(type Action (Union "process.test" "human.approve"))

(type StepIR {:kind "Step" :name Symbol :action Action})
(form (step name action)
  :types {:name (Declares Step) :action Action}
  :ir StepIR
  {:kind "Step" :name name :action action})

(type WorkflowIR {:kind "Workflow" :name Symbol :steps (List StepIR)})
(form (workflow name step ...)
  :types {:name (Declares Workflow) :step (List step)}
  :ir WorkflowIR
  {:kind "Workflow" :name name :steps step})
repairText: Change process.tset to the allowed action process.test.
outcome: A checked release plan, ready for your tooling.
consumer: Your application gives these steps meaning. Forma has not run tests, requested approval or scheduled a workflow.

diagnostic.help: Use a value matching the declared type of action.

label: Schema & query
title: Let a schema shape its query language.
introduction: The ontology prelude introduces entity fields into a query’s scope and requires a Bool predicate.
prelude:
(form (query name {:keys [from where select]})
  "A named read over one entity."
  :examples
    [[(entity Person {:name String :age Int})
      (query adults :from Person :where (>= age 18) :select [name])]]
  :types
    {
      :name (Declares QueryDef)
      :from (Refers SchemaDecl)
      :where (Option (Expr Bool))
      :select (Option (List Symbol))}
  :scope {:where (fn [{:keys [from]}] (entity-fields from))}
  :type (fn [{:keys [from select]}] (List (row-of from select)))
  :ir QueryIR
  :extensions {:artifact {:validators ["domain-payload"]}}
  {
    :kind "Query"
    :name name
    :from from
    :where where
    :select (map (fn [field] (keyword from field)) (or select []))})
source:
(entity Department {:name String})

(entity Employee {:name String
    :department (Option (Id Department))
    :active Bool})

(query employee-directory
  :from Employee
  :where active
  :select [name department])

repairText: Use active, a Bool field, instead of name, a String field.
outcome: A checked query with qualified field names.
consumer: Your application interprets the Query IR. This story does not execute SQL, contact a database or return employee records.

label: Effect contract
title: Make a service requirement explicit.
introduction: The supported Effect language tracks the failures and service requirements of an operation.
preludeExcerpt:
(error ConsoleUnavailable {:message String})

(service Console
  (: print
    (-> String
      (Effect Unit [ConsoleUnavailable] []))))
source:
(error ConsoleUnavailable {:message String})

(service Console
  (: print (-> String (Effect Unit [ConsoleUnavailable] []))))

(: log (-> String (Effect Unit [ConsoleUnavailable] [Console.print])))
(define log [message]
  (do! [_ (Console.print message)]
    (succeed nil)))
